about: Twelve fixed one-line briefs. An agent builds each from docs/games/good-game.md alone; pnpm games:score --briefs reports which checks each built game passes. Don't edit a brief: add a new version of the file instead, so scores stay comparable.

briefs.brief: A penalty shootout: five kicks each, striker against goalkeeper, sudden death after a draw.
A three-lap kart race on a small island circuit for up to eight drivers, with CPU drivers filling empty karts.
An archery range: three rounds of three arrows at a moving target, highest total wins.
Freeze tag in a walled garden: one chaser, everyone else runs, two-minute rounds.
Ten-pin bowling on two lanes, a full ten-frame game, taking turns.
A hedge maze race: first to the fountain in the middle wins, and the maze changes every round.
Sumo on a round platform: push the others off the edge, best of five rounds.
A fishing pond: cast, wait, reel; heaviest catch after three minutes wins.
A climbing wall race up a twenty-metre tower with a handhold route that differs each match.
A dance floor rhythm game: step on the lit tiles in time through one ninety-second song.
Nine holes of minigolf, fewest strokes wins, everyone playing the same hole at once.
Capture the flag between two teams on a small symmetrical field, first to three captures.
